entries.title: Psalms 61:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On a stringed instrument. [A Psalm] of David.>> Hear, O God, my cry; attend unto my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 61:2
segments: From the end of the earth will I call unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: thou wilt lead me on to a rock which is too high for me.

entries.title: Psalms 61:3
segments: For thou hast been a refuge for me, a strong tower from before the enemy.

entries.title: Psalms 61:4
segments: I will sojourn in thy tent for ever; I will take refuge in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 61:5
segments: ¶For thou, O God, hast heard my vows; thou hast given [me] the inheritance of those that fear thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 61:6
segments: Thou wilt add days to the days of the king: his years shall be as many generations.

entries.title: Psalms 61:7
segments: He shall abide before God for ever: bestow loving-kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

entries.title: Psalms 61:8
segments: So will I sing forth thy name for ever, performing my vows from day to day.
